description: Golden cases for the curated tool catalog contract (Treg parity B3), asserted by ryu_gw_contracts::tool_catalog and @ryuhq/protocol/tool-catalog. validation lists an entry and the sorted codes it breaks on its own; transitions apply one verification result; select merges a Ryu and a Treg entry under a precedence; paidRouting names an entry and the built-in price row it is paired with (null for none). catalogChecks validate the named entries together as one catalog (built-in taxonomy and prices); beside lists the generated entries that may sit beside curated ones (curated wins on a shared endpoint id or provider operation).

validation.name: a valid unverified entry
a valid verified entry
a valid drifted entry keeps its last pass
a valid retired entry may have no probes
verified needs both dates
a pass date needs its method
verified cannot postdate the last check
verified carries no reason
drift needs a reason and a date
retirement needs a reason
only a retired entry names a successor
a live entry needs a probe
dates must be calendar dates
the endpoint belongs to its provider
a curated entry names its capability and platform
docs and probe URLs are HTTPS
markers are trimmed and at least three characters
a docs probe needs a marker
a credential must be on the verifier allowlist
a credential goes only to its own host
a paid probe needs a credential
expected status is a 2xx
a GET has no body
the recorded method needs a probe that can prove it
at most four probes
a generated entry may omit its capability and platform
a generated entry names its spec and operation
only a generated entry names a spec
any entry may name the operation it describes
spec and operation fields are checked
an operation path is a path template, not a URL
a generated entry never carries half a taxonomy reference
a free route on a credential-free live GET is valid
a free route needs a GET operation
a free route is verified without a credential
a free route base is HTTPS
only a curated entry may be a free route

transitions.name: a pass verifies an unverified entry
a mismatch drifts a verified entry and keeps its last pass
a mismatch drifts an unverified entry
an error is not a verdict
a skip is not a verdict
a stale result cannot undo a newer verdict
a pass without a method is invalid and ignored
the same pass again changes nothing

expect: Base price, with up to 10 results (per 1k requests) $4 $7
Cost per additional result above 10 (per 1k requests) $1

curated_exa_instant.title: Exa search (instant)

curated_exa_instant.note: Exa's search reference marks `instant` legacy (use lite) and prices it as Lite Search.

verification.reason: no longer in the vendor's published spec

select.name: verified first: Ryu's verified entry wins
verified first: Treg wins over unverified Ryu
verified first: Treg wins over drifted Ryu
verified first: unverified Ryu without Treg
treg first falls back to Ryu

paidRouting.name: a verified entry with a verified free price
a verified generated entry without a price refuses
a generated entry never borrows another endpoint's price
a generated entry a docs check verified never routes a paid call, even with its own endpoint's price
the curated entry for that endpoint and price does

catalogChecks.name: a generated entry needs no price and no taxonomy reference
curated body variants may share an operation
a generated entry may not repeat a live entry's operation
a retired generated entry collides with nothing
a curated entry still needs its price
a price row joined to a generated entry is refused

beside.name: curated wins on a shared operation
curated wins on a shared endpoint id
nothing curated keeps every generated entry

freeRoute.name: a live-verified free route with a free price is served
a free route without a price is not served
a free route on a metered price is not served
a free route verified only on its docs page is not served
an entry without a free route is never served without a key
